The release that closes the gap between the pitch and the product: your prompt is now a signal, every privacy-adjacent input is opt-in, and the soundtrack actually moves the dials.

**Read the room, no setup**
- **Prompt intent** — ship/think/debug/focus read straight from the words you just typed: "let's ship it" → decisive/act-freely, "why is this failing" → verify-first. The "same prompt, different room" behavior now fires with zero configuration; a deliberate `cadence report` still outranks it.
- **Move with the music** — energy drives pace AND posture, acoustic texture warms tone. Proactivity stays yours: the soundtrack never decides whether to act without asking.

**Opt-in signals** (`cadence enable <signal>` — off until you say so)
- **typing tempo** — rapid-fire short prompts read fast; one long considered prompt reads deliberate
- **focused app** (macOS) — the frontmost non-terminal app as context flavor
- **moon / horoscope** — render-only flavor, never steers the work
- **Spotify cross-platform** — `cadence spotify connect` (PKCE browser flow) reads currently-playing off-Mac; vibe still from MusicBrainz, no audio-features

**Fresher state**
- Self-report TTL 4h → 2h, with a session-start nudge to refresh as it nears expiry
- PostToolUse now also flags destructive-git thrash (reset --hard streaks, force-pushes), once per transition

**New DX**
- `/cadence:setup` — conversational onboarding: tell Claude how you work, it drives the CLI
- `/cadence:pause` / `/cadence:resume` — instant kill switch; every hook checks it first, state survives untouched
- `cadence enable|disable`, `cadence pause|resume`, `cadence spotify connect` in the CLI

**Faster + clearer**
- Hooks exit as soon as they've spoken: the budget timer no longer holds the
  process open (~1.4s shaved off every prompt; measured 161ms end-to-end)
- `cadence state` is now `cadence report` (says what it is; old name kept as an
  alias for alpha installs), and the time/weather/battery signal is named
  `environment` throughout

71 tests, 0 failures. Docs rebuilt so the README is the manual and the landing page is the why.

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@cullumco/cadence
